title: Secure Python Pipeline Template: A Four-Gate DevSecOps Pipeline for Python Projects
description: An immediately forkable GitHub Actions pipeline template integrating Semgrep (SAST), Trufflehog v3 (secrets), Bandit (Python vulns), and pip-audit (dependency CVEs) with custom Python security rules and an evaluation harness against five real-world OSS Python projects.
